enforce the law: It is the job of the police to enforce the law and keep everyone in the city safe.
執法並維護城市裡每個人的安全是警察的職責。
enforce rules: The school has decided to enforce rules about phone use more strictly, so students must hand in their phones every morning.
學校決定更嚴格地執行使用手機的規定，所以學生每天早上都必須繳交手機。
enforce discipline: The new coach tries to enforce discipline by making players who arrive late run extra laps.
新教練藉由要求遲到的球員多跑幾圈，來嚴格要求紀律。
enforce a contract: If the company refuses to pay, we can go to court to enforce a contract that both sides signed.
如果那家公司拒絕付款，我們可以上法院強制對方履行雙方簽署的合約。
engage in conversation: At the party, she tried to engage in conversation with people she had never met before.
在派對上，她試著和以前從未見過的人參與談話。
engage the audience: A good speaker knows how to engage the audience by asking questions and telling funny stories.
優秀的講者懂得藉由提問和講有趣的故事來吸引觀眾。
be engaged to be married: I am engaged to be married in May, so my fiancé and I are busy planning our wedding.
我已訂婚，預計五月結婚，所以我和未婚夫正忙著籌備婚禮。
engage a lawyer: After the car accident, the family decided to engage a lawyer to help them deal with the insurance company.
車禍發生後，這家人決定聘請律師幫他們處理和保險公司之間的事。
engage the enemy: The soldiers waited quietly in the forest for the order to engage the enemy at dawn.
士兵們靜靜地在森林裡等待黎明時與敵交戰的命令。
engage students: Teachers often use games and videos to engage students who find grammar lessons boring.
老師們常用遊戲和影片讓覺得文法課很無聊的學生投入學習。
enhance quality: The factory bought new machines to enhance quality, so its products now last much longer than before.
工廠購買新機器來提升品質，所以現在產品比以前耐用得多。
enhance reputation: Winning the international science award will greatly enhance the reputation of our small school.
贏得國際科學獎將大大提升我們這所小學校的聲譽。
enhance performance: Getting enough sleep before a big game can enhance performance more than extra practice can.
大賽前有充足的睡眠，比額外練習更能提升表現。
enhance one's skills: She takes an online course every summer to enhance her skills in English writing.
她每年夏天都上線上課程，以增進自己的英文寫作技能。
enjoy good health: My grandfather walks for an hour every day, and at ninety he still enjoys good health.
我爺爺每天走路一小時，九十歲了身體仍然很健康。
enjoy success: After years of hard work, the small bakery began to enjoy success and opened three new shops.
經過多年的努力，這家小麵包店開始獲得成功，並開了三家新分店。
enjoy the right to: In a free country, all citizens enjoy the right to say what they think without fear.
在自由的國家，所有公民都享有說出自己想法而不必害怕的權利。
enjoy popularity: Bubble tea continues to enjoy popularity among young people both in Taiwan and abroad.
珍珠奶茶在台灣和國外的年輕人之間持續廣受歡迎。
enjoy a reputation: This hospital has long enjoyed a reputation for excellent care and friendly doctors.
這家醫院長期以來以優質的照護和親切的醫生享有好名聲。
enlarge one's vocabulary: Reading English novels is one of the best ways to enlarge your vocabulary and improve your writing.
閱讀英文小說是擴充字彙並提升寫作能力的最佳方法之一。
enlarge on a topic: The professor was asked to enlarge on a topic he had only mentioned briefly in his first lecture.
教授被要求詳述一個他在第一堂課中只簡短提過的主題。
enlarge a photo: I want to enlarge a photo of my family so that it is big enough to hang on the living room wall.
我想把一張全家福照片放大，讓它大到可以掛在客廳牆上。
ensure safety: To ensure safety, all visitors must wear helmets when they enter the building site.
為了確保安全，所有訪客進入工地時都必須戴安全帽。
ensure success: Careful planning and teamwork helped ensure success for our class's charity sale.
周詳的計畫和團隊合作幫助確保了我們班義賣活動的成功。
ensure that: Please ensure that all the windows are closed and the lights are off before you leave the classroom.
離開教室前，請確保所有窗戶都已關上、燈也已關掉。
entertain an idea: For a while, he entertained an idea of quitting his job and traveling around the world.
有一陣子，他考慮過辭掉工作去環遊世界的想法。
entertain doubts: Even after hearing his explanation, the teacher still entertained doubts about whether he had really been sick.
即使聽了他的解釋，老師對他是否真的生病了仍然心存疑慮。
entertain guests: My parents love to entertain guests, so they often cook a big dinner for friends on weekends.
我爸媽很喜歡招待客人，所以週末常常為朋友煮一頓豐盛的晚餐。
entertain the crowd: While people waited in line, a street performer juggled and told jokes to entertain the crowd.
在大家排隊等候時，一位街頭藝人表演雜耍並說笑話來娛樂群眾。
entertain hopes: Although she was injured, the young swimmer still entertained hopes of competing in the Olympics.
雖然受了傷，這位年輕的泳將仍然抱持著參加奧運的希望。
